Group Sales & Events Manager Location: Silversands Grenada Reports to: Director of Sales & Marketing About the Position As the Group and Special Experiences Manager, you are responsible for generating group and event business while ensuring the every program is meticulously planned and flawlessly executed. You are not just selling space and dates. You are shaping moments that matter. From the first conversation to the final farewell, you take ownership of each opportunity, balancing commercial goals with genuine care for our guests, clients, and colleagues. How You’ll Operate You’ll work closely with the Director of Sales and Marketing , with regular dialogue around priorities, opportunities, and challenges. Collaboration is key success in this role depends on strong partnerships with sales peers and seamless alignment with operations, culinary, and guest experience teams. This is a hands-on role that requires follow-through, accountability, and a calm, confident presence. What You’ll Be Responsible For Generating Sales & Building Relationships Proactively generating and converting group and event business within your assigned market. Taking full responsibility for all assigned leads, ensuring consistent follow-up and thoughtful progression from inquiry through confirmation. Cultivating long-term relationships with clients, travel partners, and planners, while expanding our network through targeted outreach. Identifying opportunities with future potential and developing tailored approaches to secure repeat and referral business. Presenting Silversands Grenada in a compelling and authentic way, aligning our offerings with each client’s goals and vision. Representing the resort at industry events, sales missions, and hosted experiences. Using CRM tools and sales systems to track activity, manage pipelines, and maintain accurate records. Contracts, Planning & Event Oversight Leading contract discussions and negotiations in line with resort guidelines and revenue objectives. Ensuring contractual details are clearly communicated and smoothly transitioned into planning and execution. Managing all on-property group events, site inspections, and familiarization visits. Coordinating event logistics and set-ups in partnership with operations and culinary teams. Designing and delivering memorable occasions that feel personal, seamless, and distinctly Silversands. Developing and refreshing event and offerings to remain relevant, creative, and commercially sound. Service, Collaboration & Leadership Acting as a trusted point of contact for clients, offering guidance, reassurance, and solutions throughout the planning process. Communicating clearly and proactively with internal teams to ensure expectations are aligned and delivered. Supporting colleagues and operations teams as needed to ensure overall success. Participating in required departmental and hotel meetings. Remaining attentive to safety standards and reporting concerns promptly. Taking on additional responsibilities as needed in support of the business. Commercial Accountability Ensuring proposals and pricing decisions support the financial objectives of the resort. Delivering against established room night, event, and revenue goals. Contributing insights related to demand patterns, market shifts, and client behavior to support forecasting and planning. What We’re Looking For Professional Presence & Emotional Intelligence A natural ability to connect, listen, and build trust. Confidence balanced with humility and self-awareness. A calm, solutions-oriented approach, even in high-pressure situations. Sales & Organizational Strength Strong negotiation skills and comfort managing contracts. Excellent organization, time management, and attention to detail. Ability to juggle multiple priorities without losing focus or follow-through. Collaborative Mindset A team player who values shared success. Respectful, clear communicator across all levels of the organization. Willingness to step in and support where needed. Growth-Oriented Curious, adaptable, and open to learning. Motivated to refine skills and broaden experience. Takes pride in doing things well — and doing them thoughtfully. Qualifications & Experience High school diploma required. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing,Business,Tourism & Hospitality or a related field from an accredited college or university preferred. Minimum of five (5) years’ experience within a luxury resort or hospitality environment Ref: Group & Special Experiences Manager Apply Now
